latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video for Social Media — Initial Release

- Instantly creates and exports social-ready video clips from raw footage using AI-powered cloud editing (supports TikTok, Instagram vertical clips, and more).
- Automatic setup: handles anonymous authentication and session management transparently.
- Accepts a wide range of video/audio/image file formats (up to 500MB), with support for uploading, editing, and exporting 1080p MP4s by default.
- Provides real-time status updates for uploads, credit usage, and editing progress; handles credits and registration flow for free users.
- Built-in error handling for common issues like token expiry, missing headers, and unsupported formats.
- Designed for simple, fast editing workflows—just upload, describe your cut, and download ready-to-post clips.
